data.long_meaning: One who gives, bestows, or provides prosperity and success. The name Faiz carries the meaning “Giver, Bestower, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faiz usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, bestower, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Faiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Bestower, Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faiz total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Faiz" is often associated with generosity and excellence in various Islamic societies. It is a name given to those who are believed to possess the ability to bring prosperity, success, and abundance to themselves and their communities. In some cultures, it is customary for parents to name their child Faiz as a sign of their hope for a bountiful future for their child.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Faiz" holds deep significance as it reminds us of the concept of Allah's unending blessings and mercy. It is a reminder that all good things come from Allah and that we should strive to be like Allah, who is the ultimate giver and benefactor. The name also encourages us to be generous and kind to others, as we are all the recipients of Allah's blessings. Therefore, the name Faiz is not only a source of personal pride but also a call to be a conduit of Allah's bounties in this world.
